findings.claim: The original crash remains possible because GetObjectInfo's third unguarded DeclaringSyntaxReferences[0] access (around line 735) was not changed. Wrapping reportDiagnostic does not help: the indexer is evaluated while constructing the diagnostic, before ReportIfLocatedInCompilation can inspect or drop it. Consequently, a closed generic struct whose symbol comes only from metadata can still throw IndexOutOfRangeException, producing CS8785/AD0001 and preventing the application's resolver from being generated.

receipt_plan.detail: Run ClosedGenericMetadataRecordStructReceiptTests.ClosedGenericRecordStructFromReferencedAssembly. It compiles Lib.Item<T> as a record struct into a metadata reference, then runs MessagePackGenerator and all MessagePack analyzers on the issue's App.Cmd source. On head it fails on CS8785 or AD0001; a complete fix runs cleanly.
